channel.title: European Business Wallet Requirements: what changed
channel.description: Changes in laws, standards, ecosystems and on this site.

item.title: Delegation and mandates for employees, machines and agents: 24 requirements and decision DEC-13
item.description: Onward delegation, joint representation, suspension, termination of authority, authority of devices and limits for AI agents, from the Commission proposals, DORA RTS 2024/1774, the AI Act, the CRA, IDTA Part 4 and the WE BUILD rulebooks. DEC-13 compares four ways to give authority (roles in the wallet, mandate credentials, legal powers of attorney, protocol-level delegation). The stakeholder brief now has ten themes.

item.title: 53 requirements added for gaps in mandates, key custody and cross-jurisdiction identity
item.description: Owner-side status checks and revocation of mandates (clusters K02, K03), recording, evidence and disclosure for key custody (K04) and identifiers, assurance and third-country partners (K17), from the Commission proposal, the Council text, eIDAS, CIR 2015/1502 and the WE BUILD rulebooks. Eleven custody and six identity items are derivations (class D). Mandate items cite a rulebook version newer than the registered commit and are marked for source check.

item.title: 40 cross-jurisdiction requirements added from Catena-X standards
item.description: Identification of business partners (BPN), registration and onboarding, country rules and company certificates from CX-0006, CX-0009, CX-0010, CX-0050, CX-0076, CX-0135, CX-0149, CX-0152 and CX-0167 (Neptune preview). Several conflict with the EBW scope (single issuing organisation, BPNL only for capital companies, undefined identity proofing); they are tagged for review in cluster K17.

item.title: 199 draft requirements added from official sources
item.description: Derived from the Commission proposal COM(2025) 838, the consolidated eIDAS Regulation, the EUDI Wallet implementing regulations and the ARF high-level requirements, and horizontal law (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, CRA, AI Act, Data Act). Each requirement has a verbatim source extract, a category and a provenance class. None has been reviewed by a named person yet; the AI Act and DORA entries are derivations (class D).

item.title: Concept article added: Trust list
item.description: Structure of the EU trusted list and the lists of trusted entities for wallet roles, how a relying party authenticates and uses them, with two figures. Open verification points are marked in the article.

item.title: Legal roadmap added
item.description: Swimlane roadmap chart and page with milestones, gates, Council presidencies and risks from the Commission proposal to mandatory acceptance. Periods relative to entry into force verified against the text of COM(2025) 838; calendar dates are scenarios.

item.title: Business cases added (macroeconomic, ecosystem, company)
item.description: Forty-one traced claims from the Commission impact assessment SWD(2025) 837, other official impact assessments and academic papers, with basis, caveats and verification state. The often quoted EUR 37.5 billion SME figure could not be traced to an official document.

item.title: First draft published for review
item.description: Methodology, ecosystem pages, 29 concept registry entries and the first concept article (Trust plane) are online as a draft.
